checked.item: "Reconciliation details" title and "Run reconciliation" button: I don't know what "reconciliation" means, but it is the product's precise term, so I only checked whether it is explained
"Read-only. Nothing in your books changes." reassurance (in source, not in states[] card text): good safety signal, not flagged
"Last full month — the usual close period" hint: I don't know what "close period" means, but the default is fine, so I hesitate only a little
Date range tooltip "Compares transactions dated in this range in QuickBooks and on the platform.": understandable
Custom date range: future-only and ranges ending today are accepted (Theme 4 partial). This is a correctness issue, not a clarity issue for my lens
Integration options "mzkt.by (Stripe)", "Great payments for every one (PayPal)", "My store (Shopify)": recognisable by the platform name
"Select an integration first" hint on the disabled Account field: clear
"Timezone: Europe/Minsk" and "Currency: USD" hints: informative, not confusing
Account tooltip "clearing account" and "P&L accounts": both unexplained jargon, and neither word matches the option labels
Account option "Stripe mzkt.by (required for Synder)": "required for Synder" doesn't tell me that this is the one to pick
Account group labels "Synder accounts (automated data retrieval)" / "Synder accounts (manual file upload required)": "Business Checking" is my bank account, not a Synder account
"Automatic file retrieval Recommended" card and "Large pulls can take a few hours — we’ll email you when it’s ready.": clear and reassuring
"Set import methods" / "Use automatic retrieval" toggle labels: understandable once found
Import method options "Automated (recommended)", "Assisted", "Manual": "Assisted" is never explained
Non-clearing account forces two manual uploads, including "How to get General ledger export from QuickBooks Online" and an unnamed "How to get this file"
"CSV or XLSX formats, up to 100MB": clear
Confirm "Switch to automatic retrieval? Uploaded files on this screen will be cleared.": good consequence warning, and Theme 3 is resolved
"Primary ID", "Fuzzy amount ±0.01": jargon, but the modal is labelled a prototype preview and is not on the primary path
"Reconciliation started" / "We’ll update the status when it’s ready.": doesn't name what was submitted or where the status appears (Theme 6 partial). Lower quit risk than the 3 selected findings
Error "Upload the required file" and "Select an integration": Theme 1 resolved, not re-flagged

findings.element: Account to reconcile: ? tooltip and the Stripe option list
findings.finding: The tooltip tells me to pick the "clearing account" and to avoid "P&L accounts" without explaining either term. No Stripe option contains the word "clearing". The right choice is labelled "Stripe mzkt.by (required for Synder)", so I can't connect the advice to an option.
findings.user_impact: I'm likely to pick the familiar "Business Checking" or "Stripe sales". Either choice lands me in the harder upload-only path, or on an account that can't be reconciled.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the term "clearing account" but explain it in plain words, for example "the holding account Synder uses for your Stripe money". Show the same word on the option itself (for example "Stripe mzkt.by, clearing account (recommended)") and replace "P&L" with "fee or sales accounts".

evidence.quote: Prefer the clearing account tied to this integration connection. P&L accounts (fees, sales) usually aren’t reconcilable here.

findings.element: How we get the data: Integration side upload after choosing a non-clearing account (Stripe fees / Business Checking)
findings.finding: If I pick a non-clearing account, the automatic option disappears without explanation and I'm asked for 2 uploads. The QuickBooks one is named "General ledger export", which is jargon, and the Stripe one doesn't say which file it wants.
findings.user_impact: I don't know what file to produce or why the recommended automatic option vanished, so this is where I'd close the tab.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the Stripe file explicitly, and add a line such as "This account can't be retrieved automatically, so we need 2 files. Pick the Stripe clearing account to skip uploads."

findings.element: How we get the data: Integration side Import method select (Stripe, PayPal, Shopify)
findings.finding: "Assisted" appears next to "Manual" with no explanation. It is the default for PayPal and Shopify, and it still asks for file uploads, so I can't tell how it differs from Manual.
findings.user_impact: I hesitate over which method to pick and worry that the wrong one will break the run.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one line of helper text under each method, for example "Assisted: you upload the files, and Synder tells you exactly which reports to export", or add a "What's the difference?" link.

gaps: Retrieval failure and empty-result states are not implemented (not_exercised), so I can't judge whether a failed automatic pull explains which precondition failed and how to fix it (KF-9)
Results / matched-unmatched screen is not built, so I can't assess whether the outcome is explained in plain language or what happens after "We’ll update the status when it’s ready."
The state map doesn't record any behavioural difference between Assisted and Manual beyond the upload slots shown, so I can't tell what Assisted actually does for the user
states[] visible_text covers the card only; the header reassurance "Read-only. Nothing in your books changes." was confirmed from source, not from the recon
